content: The architecture of multi-BERT is a Transformer encoder BIBREF25. While fine-tuning on SQuAD-like dataset, the bottom layers of multi-BERT are initialized from Google-pretrained parameters, with an added output layer initialized from random parameters. Tokens representations from the last layer of bottom-part of multi-BERT are inputs to the output layer and then the output layer outputs a distribution over all tokens that indicates the probability of a token being the START/END of an answer span.
